body:
PARTIAL CANDIDATE bd-01M162FEGPSY50MFHTYH3C3RHF: 1a11501 on m1/resolution. I am posting it PARTIAL and saying exactly what is missing rather than letting a green gate imply the bead is done.

IN THIS COMMIT: compression and semantic-flow coherence as ratio-of-sums, and the derived estimand version marker. NOT IN IT: mass-weighted fidelity with per-facet N_f/A_f, and expectation over the anchor distribution rather than the MAP. Those two are the larger half and I would rather they arrive with their own tests than be folded in at the end of a long stretch.

WHAT CHANGED. Both quantities were mean-of-ratios - divide inside each unit or step, then average. Your ruling's phrasing is the reason and it is worth repeating: a 0.01-mass unit got the same vote as a fully placed one. Both also invented values from nothing: compression emitted 0.0 for a unit with no source mass, and 0.0 means MAXIMALLY FINE-GRAINED - the most specific possible recall, asserted about a unit we could not place at all; coherence emitted 1.0, PERFECT, for a step with no source-to-source mass and for an empty flow.

MassRatio(value, conditioningMass, totalMass): value = N/A and is None when A is zero, support = A/T. Compression conditions on summed source mass; coherence on summed source-to-source mass. Non-case class with private[align] trusted construction and a checked `of`, so it does not repeat the forge.

estimandVersion is DERIVED from the code as you required - "recall-signature/v2" - never caller-supplied. A caller-set version is an assertion about what produced the numbers that nothing verifies, which is the same defect rejected for portable sensitivity.

THE MUTATION THAT MATTERED. W2 - revert compression to mean-of-ratios - SURVIVED my first test set. My tests checked that the value abstains without conditioning mass, which mean-of-ratios also satisfies. The two formulas only diverge when units carry UNEQUAL source mass, and my assertions never looked at the denominator. The test that kills it asserts the conditioning mass EQUALS THE SUMMED SOURCE MASS and is not the row count - 2.629 versus 4.0 on the fixture. That is the fifth time tonight a mutant survived because my corpus could not reach the distinction; I am now writing the distinguishing assertion first and the abstention assertion second, because abstention is the easy half to satisfy accidentally.

W1 - make a no-conditioning ratio 0.0 instead of None - FAILS.

EVIDENCE at 1a11501, clean pin, gate last from the committed tree: alignJVM 163/163, alignJS 163/163, lawsJVM 81/81, interviewJVM 76/76, embedBench 50/50, fixturesJVM 108/108, compileAll all three platforms, scalafmt both green. ClockPanel in embed-bench carries compression as Option now and its renderer prints n/a.

Stack on m1/resolution is seven, parent eda2d37. Fidelity and the anchor expectation follow as a separate candidate.
